main_text.p: Idem probatur, si officium magi-stratus rité attendas. Philosophus lib.5.Ethic.cap.6. magistratum vel principem dicit esse custodem ejus, quod justum est, atqui ita etiam illius quod æquale est, at rectius apostolus Rom. 13. 4. magistratum dicit esse minis-trum Dei, nobis ad bonum, vindicem ad defendenda recte facta, & punien-da delicta gladio.

Hoc si fieri debeat, necesse est, ut primo omnium de constituendo vero Dei cultu cogitet, verā, & maximè incorruptam religionem amplectatur, & sartam tectam, quantum potest, promoveat, atque exemplo pio suis subditis præeat.
Atque hæc sunt adeo manifesta, ut neque ex profanis scriptoribus quisquam disseruerit de magistra-tuum officio, ferendis legib. & statu publico, quin à religione & divino cultu fecerit initium.
Quomodo autem poterit cogi-tare de constituendo vero Dei cultu, & curare ut verbum Dei incorru-ptè prædicetur, utque omnia recte

page.notes: The "&" at the lower right may be a catchword or a printed sign; it is recorded as a catchword. The top of the page shows the page number "137" with some blur. Some words are doubtful because of uneven ink and show-through: "rité" and "rectè" are read as printed with accents, and "verā" may be "verâ". The lower-right "&" and the hyphenated words at line ends were copied with their printed hyphens. Show-through from the reverse side is present but was not transcribed.
